meaning:
1) coming round, circuit of time or space, a turning, circuit
1a) at the circuit (as adverb)

renderings.kjv: And it came to pass at the end

elsewhere.note: “You shall observe the feast of weeks with the first fruits of wheat harvest, and the feast of harvest at the year’s end.
When the time had come, Hannah conceived, and bore a son; and she named him Samuel, saying, “Because I have asked him of Yahweh.”
At the end of the year, the army of the Syrians came up against him: and they came to Judah and Jerusalem, and destroyed all the princes of the people from…
His going out is from the end of the heavens, his circuit to its ends. There is nothing hidden from its heat.
